name: EV3 / microSD Pybricks 2.0 · experimental
description: EV3 con microSD LEGO Education EV3 MicroPython (ev3dev + Pybricks 2.0). Descarga manual de main.py; firmware original conservado. Experimental.

en.EV3 con microSD LEGO Education EV3 Micro: EV3 with LEGO Education EV3 MicroPython microSD (ev3dev + Pybricks 2.0). Manual main.py transfer; original firmware preserved. Experimental.
en.Un dispositivo físico por puerto. Las re: One physical device per port. References reuse the same device; this is not GPIO.
en.Detiene el programa desde el sistema del: Stops the program from the brick system; not part of Button in Pybricks 2.0.
en.Descarga la imagen oficial EV3 MicroPyth: Download the official EV3 MicroPython image following the installation guide.
en.Graba la imagen en una microSD de al men: Write the image to a microSD card of at least 4 GB with balenaEtcher.
en.Con el EV3 apagado, coloca la microSD y: With the EV3 turned off, insert the microSD card and turn it on.
en.Descarga main.py desde RobotBlocks y cóp: Download main.py from RobotBlocks and copy it to the EV3. See the Detailed guide for transfer instructions.
en.Apaga el EV3 y saca la microSD. Al encen: Turn off the EV3 and remove the microSD card. When turned on, it returns to the original LEGO firmware (EV3-G); the microSD does not modify it.
